name: Verify Numerical Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to make correct decisions or inferences from numerical or statistical data presented in graphs, charts, and tables. Suitable for roles requiring data interpretation and financial judgment.

name: Verify Verbal Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to understand and evaluate written information. Suitable for roles requiring strong communication, document comprehension, or policy interpretation.

name: Verify Inductive Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to identify patterns and logical rules in abstract sequences. Best for roles requiring strategic thinking, innovation, or complex problem-solving.

name: Verify Deductive Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to draw logical conclusions from given premises. Suitable for analytical, legal, and consulting roles.

name: Verify Mechanical Comprehension
description: Measures understanding of mechanical and physical principles. Ideal for engineering, manufacturing, technical trades, and maintenance roles.

name: Verify Checking
description: Measures accuracy and attention to detail when comparing information. Best for data entry, administrative, and clerical roles.

name: Verify G+ (General Ability)
description: A combined measure of verbal, numerical, and inductive reasoning providing an overall general cognitive ability score. Efficient for broad screening across a wide range of roles.

name: OPQ (Occupational Personality Questionnaire)
description: Measures 32 personality characteristics related to workplace performance across relationships with people, thinking style, and feelings and emotions. Used for leadership, management, sales, and culture-fit assessment.

name: MQ (Motivation Questionnaire)
description: Measures what energises and motivates individuals at work across 18 motivational dimensions. Helps predict engagement, retention risk, and role fit.

name: ADEPT-15
description: A short validated personality assessment covering 15 key workplace traits. Designed for high-volume hiring where speed and efficiency matter.

name: Situational Judgement Test (SJT)
description: Presents candidates with realistic work scenarios and asks how they would respond. Assesses judgment and behavioural tendencies. Ideal for graduate programmes, customer-facing, and managerial roles.

name: Global Skills Assessment (GSA)
description: Evaluates critical workplace competencies including communication, collaboration, adaptability, and problem-solving across global talent pools.

name: Work Safety Assessment
description: Measures safety-conscious attitudes and behaviours to identify candidates likely to follow safety procedures and reduce workplace accidents. Best for manufacturing, logistics, construction, and high-risk environments.

name: Job-Focused Assessments
description: A suite of assessments tailored to specific job families such as contact centre, retail, administrative, and professional services, combining cognitive and behavioural measures calibrated to the target role.

name: Call Centre Simulation
description: Simulates real contact centre tasks including handling calls, managing customer queries, and multitasking. Predicts on-the-job performance in customer service and BPO roles.

name: Business Skills Assessment
description: Evaluates practical business skills such as writing, data analysis, prioritisation, and business communication. Suitable for professional, graduate, and managerial roles.

name: Coding Simulations
description: Assesses real-world coding skills through hands-on simulations across multiple languages and frameworks. Best for software engineering and technical roles.

name: Technical Skills Assessment
description: Measures job-specific technical knowledge in areas such as IT, engineering, finance, and operations. Configurable to the specific requirements of the role.

name: Language Proficiency Assessment
description: AI-powered spoken and written language proficiency tests covering multiple languages. Suitable for customer-facing, international, and multilingual roles.

name: Assessment & Development Centre
description: A comprehensive blended assessment approach combining exercises such as role plays, group discussions, presentations, and in-trays. Used for senior hiring, leadership identification, and succession planning.
